name: Cube
summary: Cube puts annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario planning and variance analysis on top of Excel and Google Sheets. It publishes no prices: Bronze, Silver and Gold are quoted by entity count, with 1, up to 10 and up to 50 legal entities, and all plans include unlimited users.

facts.text: The pricing page says no prices are published and that pricing is configured with each customer around entities, sources and teams.
Cube states that it is SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II certified and HIPAA compliant, with reports available on request.
Multicurrency consolidation is an add-on on Bronze and Silver and is included in Gold.
Companies with more than 50 entities or more than 1 TB of data are directed to a custom Strategic quote.

plans.name: Bronze
plans.notes: 4 hours of training; no Slack, Teams, SSO or advanced role-based access listed

plans.name: Silver
plans.notes: 12 hours of training; adds Slack, Teams, workflows, SSO and advanced role-based access

plans.name: Gold
plans.notes: Includes everything in Silver; the plan card and comparison table disagree on whether premium support is included

plans.name: Strategic
plans.notes: For 50 or more entities or more than 1 TB of data

hiddenCosts: Premium Support+, Additional Modules and API Access are add-ons on any plan, and none has a published price.
Multicurrency consolidation is an add-on on Bronze and Silver.
